Re: Please reject the El Paso Natural Gas Company Blanket Authorization



I certainly would not want one of these projects to be built in Orlando or anywhere else for
that matter. Please reject this project. I am writing with deep concern regarding El Paso
Natural Gas Company's request to construct, install, modify, operate and maintain an
approximately 5.8-mile, 16-inch diameter pipeline lateral, and appurtenances, connecting
EPNG's parallel Line Nos. 1100 and 1103 to the proposed McCloud Meter Station at the
terminus of the pipeline lateral. The project in question will further entrench polluting gas
infrastructure that negatively impacts communities and our planet by incentivizing
continued and expanding fossil fuel use. At a time when the climate crisis is worsening, we
should be looking to embrace sustainable forms of energy like wind or solar rather than
doubling down on dirty forms of energy that pollute our communities and contribute to
climate chaos. Furthermore, communities across the country are being impacted by the
completely unregulated deployment of massive data center projects that are straining our
water resources, spiking our energy bills, worsening the climate crisis, and disrupting the
fabric of our communities. This gas project in El Paso could enable a data center project in
New Mexico that could have serious consequence for local communities. Please protect
Texas and New Mexico residents and the planet by rejecting this pipeline project.

Thank you.



Lois Mills

Orlando, FL 328034535
